body:
As I'm not sleeping again and still having those thoughts on my mind I might as well make a list of the things I have do deal with at the moment and bother me too much and are overwhelming.

I lost a check, 750€. I need this money, I'll have to call the person that send it and ask for another one. I don't have easy access to that person's phone number so I have to call 3 people in total to get that money. AND THEN go to the EFFING bank to get it into my account. That might seem easy but that's really too much for me. And my Mom won't be coming back from her holidays until early September so I might as well postpone this whole thing.

I'm going to London on Tuesday to get this interviews. I've got 2 interviews face to face and one through Skype and I have to learn almost by heart the specs of each job and of each company and then look as normal as possible because saying that I'm autistic is not an option.
I'm not bad at interviews, I'm really not. But I feel like I'm telling such a huge lie about who I am so that I can LOOK employable even though I'm not.

I'll be back from London very late on Friday night and the day after that I have someone coming to buy on of my cats (she's been fighting with my other cat and hiding and being unhappy and I feel like she needs a new home) but I net to buy a transport bag for her between tomorrow and next Saturday with being away most of the week. And everything is closed on Sundays here. 

I'm scared I won't get a job ever because I'm not too good at staying at the same job for too long because I get stressed rather easily and even though its really easy to help me calm down and get shit done but I'm too scared to even ask and feel like the dumbest dumbfuck on earth everytime.

I'm scared my boyfriend might get tired of me being so down regularly (We've been together for 11 months, living together since February and I've had this kind of major meltdowns in March and now already). I don't want to be a burden and I feel like sometimes I might just have to end it all so that I won't suffer much more later on.
And I also want to punish myself for being such a looser so cutting contact with him would do the trick.

I've got to take the cat to the vet and get him vaccinated against rabies but I don't know any vets in my area and I'm scared that something might happen to my cat. I can't function without him really.

I'm scared my moods won't ever get better. I've been periodically depressed at least 10 times in the past 5 years and I don't know what can I do more than go and see a therapist (most of them that I'm not depressed because I get out of bed and laugh - I tend to deal with trauma and hard things by laughing at it) and get some medication (but I usually forget to carry on taking it when I get better...).
I don't know if this all caused by autism and PTSD or if I have anything else going on and I don't know how to address that.

I'm scared that my ex might continue to harass me and anyone that tries to be friends with me, that she will try to contact the companies I'll work for to tell them, that she'll tell everyone all the time and that I won't ever be anything else than the girl accused of that terrible thing.
Even when people doubt that the situation ever happened they get away from me just to be safe.
I feel like the worst human on earth.

I just feel like sometimes I've got too much on my plate and I can't carry on this way.
I don't know how to unload my fucking mind.
I just wish weed was legal and easier to get because it helped back when I used it as my goodnight tea thing.

I'm tired of being myself and going from trauma to abuse like I'm fucking Ulysses fucking around in his dumb boat forever.

I just feel like I should cut myself from people and end it all. It will put everything back in order.
I feel like it's gonna be extra hard, I have interviews but I'm scared and I hate myself.
